lessons: Not enough data to definitively determine which hook types keep people past the first seconds, as only one video ('Why Cold Water Fails Against Spicy Food') provides a hook line, and its start retention vs similar is low (0.33).
Not enough data to determine specific line types causing viewer drop-off, as 'biggest_drops' lines are missing for two out of three videos and drops happen across varied timestamps.
Not enough data to compare best-holding videos against others, because overall retention variance across the small sample size is too narrow.
